title: 第21章 成仙地养尸地才对第22章 初代瑶池圣女新成员入群
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
“轰隆——”
恐怖的极道威压席卷而来。
眼前的这一具女尸生前绝对是一位成道者，就是不知道是神话时代的天尊，还是太古早期的古皇……
“嗡！”
淡淡的杀阵显化而出。
虚空中凝聚出了一个【娲】字，这是女尸生前留下的手段，专门用来警告踏足此地的人。
见此。
林昭的眼神微微闪烁。
“娲？”
他看着眼前的这一具女尸，心中不由自主的想到了一个人——荒古时代的女娲大帝！
“莫非……”
“眼前的这一具女尸就是未来的女娲大帝？”
林昭心中猜测。
就从目前的情况来看。
眼前的这一具女尸正处于极阴转阳的关键时刻，或许百万年后，她的体内便能够诞生一抹生机，最后成功在这一处成仙地内养尸成功——帝尸通灵！
“百万年后差不多就是荒古时代了。”
“所以这一具女尸还真有可能是未来的女娲大帝！？”
林昭有些诧异。
他看着眼前的这一具女尸。
有心想要帮她一把，助其加快极阴转阳的进度，因为他想要观摩一下帝尸通灵的过程，未来或许能够从中得到感悟，在今后的蜕变之路上少走些弯路……

一念至此。
林昭不再迟疑。
只见他一步踏出。
来到了水晶棺的旁边，随即挥手抹除了周围的阵法，打开棺盖近距离的观察了一下女尸。
哪怕死去了几十上百万年。
女尸的身躯依旧饱满，富有弹性，肌肤白腻，身姿婀娜，宛若一位睡美人般优雅精致……
林昭近距离观摩了一番。
他正在凝视着女尸体内的死气，思考着该如何帮助对方加快通灵的进度。
在经过一番观察后。
林昭的心中便有了想法，他挥手在周围布置了一座阵法，针对性的借助昆仑成仙地的龙气来帮助女尸加快极阴转阳的过程。
有了这座阵法的帮助。
这一具女尸或许能够在五万年内通灵成功。
做完这一切。
林昭便转身离开了。
他打算等五万年后再来查看。
林昭继续朝着成仙地腹地深入，这里一共有着九十九座龙山相互交织，其中各大龙脉的交汇地数不胜数，简直是天然的养尸地……
昆仑成仙地？
不不不！
叫它养尸地更加合适！
虚假的葬帝星——北斗！
content_en:
"Boom——"
The terrifying extreme pressure swept over.
The female corpse in front of me was definitely an enlightened person during her lifetime, but I don’t know if she was a deity from the mythical era or an ancient emperor from the early ancient times...
"Buzz!"
A faint killing formation appeared.
The word "娲" condensed in the void. This was a method left by the female corpse during her lifetime, specifically used to warn people who set foot in this place.
See this.
Lin Zhao's eyes flickered slightly.
"Wa?"
He looked at the female corpse in front of him, and he couldn't help but think of a person in his heart - Emperor Nuwa from the ancient times!
"Could it be..."
"Is this female corpse in front of me the future Emperor Nuwa?"
Lin Zhao made a guess in his mind.
Judging from the current situation.
The female corpse in front of her is at the critical moment of turning from extreme yin to yang. Perhaps a million years later, a touch of life will be born in her body, and she will finally succeed in raising the corpse in this immortal place - the emperor's corpse is psychic!
"A million years from now it will almost be the ancient times."
"So it's really possible that this female corpse is the future Emperor Nuwa!?"
Lin Zhao was a little surprised.
He looked at the female corpse in front of him.
He wanted to help her speed up the process of turning from extreme yin to yang, because he wanted to observe the process of the emperor's corpse channeling spirits. In the future, he might be able to gain insights from it and avoid detours on the road to transformation in the future...
This is the thought.
Lin Zhao no longer hesitated.
I saw him take one step forward.
Arriving next to the crystal coffin, he immediately waved his hand to erase the surrounding formations, opened the coffin lid and took a closer look at the female corpse.
Even if he has been dead for tens or millions of years.
The body of the female corpse is still plump and elastic, with white and greasy skin and graceful posture, as elegant and delicate as a sleeping beauty...
Lin Zhao took a closer look.
He was staring at the death energy inside the female corpse, thinking about how to help the other party speed up the progress of channeling.
After some observation.
Lin Zhao had an idea in his mind. He waved his hand and set up a formation around him, specifically using the dragon energy from the Kunlun Immortal Land to help the female corpse speed up the process of turning from extreme yin to yang.
With the help of this formation.
This female corpse may be able to successfully channel spirits within 50,000 years.
Do it all.
Lin Zhao turned around and left.
He plans to wait 50,000 years before checking again.
Lin Zhao continued to go deep into the hinterland of the Immortal Land. There were a total of ninety-nine dragon mountains intertwined with each other. Among them, there were countless intersections of major dragon veins. It was simply a natural place to raise corpses...
Kunlun is the land of immortality?
No no no!
It would be more appropriate to call it a place to raise corpses!
The false emperor-burial star - Beidou!
